scenario: Timeout after network acceptance must remain UNKNOWN and query/reconcile, not re-post.
Duplicate webhook and client retry produce no duplicate ledger posting.
Out-of-order settled/rejected messages cannot silently reverse a finalized journal.
Settlement discrepancy creates case and blocks automatic finality.
Forged callback and expired certificate are rejected and audited.
Insufficient funds or limit failure creates no external instruction.
Merchant QR payload is validated under verified scheme specifications.
Disaster recovery replay preserves deduplication and journal balances.
